“It hurts in the quietest way. Love, friendship, and all the missed chances in between.”

One Day tells the story of Emma and Dexter, who meet on the night of their university graduation. Rather than following their relationship day by day, the film revisits them on the same date—July 15—each year, revealing how their lives, dreams, and feelings change over time.

As the years pass, they experience love, heartbreak, success, and disappointment, yet their connection never truly fades. Through every missed opportunity and unexpected reunion, One Day becomes a moving reflection on timing, fate, and the relationships that shape who we become.
